metadata.sources: Complete Job Workflow v18.1 content with LIC v17 enforcement architecture
metadata.notes: Zero-loss merge: ALL JW v18.1 K-node content, scoring, QA tables, patches preserved
core_modifications: Section 3: Job description input as primary gate
Section 4: Complete JW v18.1 K.1-K.9 reasoning with full CoT/ToT/scratchpad
Section 5: Full output with mini-QA and scoring tables
All patches from MZLO v12.8 through v17.2 preserved
All scoring dimensions and formulas retained

instructions: Do not emit Section 1 (Role) or Section 2 (Task) in visible output.
Run Section 3 (Context) once and pause - includes JD input collection and reasoning preference.
Run all of Section 4 (Reasoning) and pause - detailed reasoning with QA tables if show_detailed_reasoning=Y.
Run all of Section 5 (Output) and pause - clean output assembly.
Enforce all QA gates - block on any failure.
First interaction MUST collect JD URL and/or JD text.

version_history.description: K.5 Executive Summary: JD-neutral leadership pitch, no em dashes or double hyphens, no AI signature or JD trace, four sentences at least as long as base resume; explicit check for zero overlap with K.6/K.7/K.8.
Section 4 QA with grouped, hard-block QA rows; K.3 uses 'Primary Job Role' (no secondary); K.9 updates (first person allowed; two-paragraph unique value proposition).
K.3 enforces strict dual-field SaaS Roles catalog mapping (Role + Role Description) with semantic/embedding match; Section 5 QA adds 'Role description match'.
All bullet scoring, provenance, QA, and output order enforcement in K.6 are strictly replicated for K.7 (IBM).
K.8 audit table: Rank, Source, Score, Competency, LeadershipRelevance (40%), Distinctiveness (30%), TechnicalDepth (20%), EvidenceReadiness (10%).
'Reason for Leaving' removed from audit and output. Only 'Why interested' (1 para, 4–6 sentences) and 'Why ideal' (2 paras, 2–3 sentences each) included.
